question: The Pudhumai Penn scheme is launched by which state government?
solution:
The correct answer is __Tamil Nadu.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin on 5 September 2022 launched the 'Pudhumai Penn' (modern woman) scheme in Chennai.
 
• Under this scheme, all girl students, who studied from Classes 6 to 12 in govt schools, will get Rs 1,000 per month to pursue higher education.
 
• The scheme aims to benefit six lakh girls every year and Rs 698 crore has been allocated in the budget for its implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Tamil Nadu is a state in southern India.
 
• Tamil Nadu is the tenth-largest Indian state by area and the sixth-largest by population.
 
• It is famed for its Dravidian-style Hindu temples.
 
• It ranks 11th among all Indian states in the human development index.
 
• ​Tamil Nadu:
 
 
• Governor: R. N. Ravi
 
• Capital: Chennai
 
• Chief Minister: M. K. Stalin
 
• Official Language: Tamil
 
 

c3:T
